limits.en: Basic project and task management for individuals and small teams up to 10 members.

keyLimits.en: Up to 10 team members, basic task/project management.
Timeline, workflows, custom fields, unlimited free guests.
Requires a minimum of 2 seats; adds portfolios, goals, advanced reporting and approvals.

cautions.en: Advanced plan has a 2-seat minimum, so a true solo user cannot buy it alone; Starter is the smallest paid tier a single person can purchase.

capabilities.en: Task and project management with lists, boards, timeline (Gantt) and calendar views.
Workflow automation rules and cross-project reporting dashboards.

limitations.en: Free plan is capped at 10 team members.
Portfolios, goals and advanced reporting require the Advanced tier, which has a 2-seat purchase minimum.

reason.en: Direct all-in-one project management competitor with a similar freemium structure.
Work OS competitor covering similar project and workflow management use cases.
Lighter, board-based alternative for teams that find Asana too structured.
Flexible workspace alternative often chosen by solo freelancers instead of a dedicated PM tool.

unknowns: Enterprise plan pricing is quote-only and was not captured numerically.
